prior_campaign_comparison: Different source, turbo policy and controls; timing changes from the provisional campaign are not isolated code effects.

host.affinity: physical CPUs 0-15, socket 0, NUMA node 0; housekeeping 32-47
host.frequency_policy: performance, selected-core min=max=2400000kHz; observed samples include idle transitions

policy.xmx_scope: TLC Java heap only; native whole-process budget is recorded from each arm report
policy.schedule: model order fixed; worker/arm blocks reversed on odd repetitions; one process at a time
qualifications: The frozen runner retains quiet_window_certified=false. Separate before/after CPU controls, passive five-second telemetry and hardware throttle counters are audited independently; passive sampling cannot attribute every short-lived process between samples.
Four TLC-profile requested-8-worker models actually use one worker; they receive no scaling credit.
All-model throughput is descriptive and includes small/initial-only graphs; acceptance population unchanged.

telemetry.qualification: Passive five-second telemetry; unrelated-process CPU is an all-core bound for observed processes, not a claim that short-lived processes between samples are individually attributed. Kernel busy/steal counters include all selected-core work. Frequency readings include idle transitions; control min/max and turbo/SMT attestation are separate.
